description: List the user's recurring time blocks: their ideal day / ideal week ("Meditation" every day at 08:00, "Writing" on weekday mornings). A recurring block is also a habit: each day it appears on the timeline as a regular block the user checks off (see list_day_blocks), and consecutive checked days form a streak. `weekdays` is the rule in force on the given date; `next_change` announces a rule already recorded for later (a repetition that starts or stops on a future date).

date.description: Date the rule is read at (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today (UTC).

include_stopped.description: Also return repetitions that no longer plan anything (default false)

name: list_recurring_blocks
